observations.summary: Never pour cooking oil or grease down the drain; eliminate or limit garbage disposal use (tank needs pumping more often with one); spreading laundry across the week; a running toilet can add up to 200 gallons per day; only human waste and toilet paper in the toilet.
observations.inference_limit: National homeowner guidance; not a local code requirement.

observations.summary: Never pour fats, oil or grease down sinks or toilets; pour cooled grease into a covered container for the garbage; soak up spills with absorbent material; do not push large amounts of food into the disposal; use sink strainers; sewer spills pollute Monterey Bay.
observations.inference_limit: District guidance for sewered homes; applied to septic homes alongside EPA advice.

observations.summary: Citing EPA: grease is the most common cause of reported sewer blockages (47 percent); hot water and soap do not remove grease.
observations.inference_limit: Extension summary of EPA data; national figure.
